content:
What's the best way to managing imports in project with multiple files?
If I go and make even the most minor change in one file, all the other files that depend on it, start saying that the imports are out of date. What's the best way to manage this "problem"?

You can (and should) use the module system, then you can have public and private imports. For example, changing stuff in proofs wont lead to large rebuild times then.

Also this may be obvious, but in each file only import the files you really need (you can use the #min_imports command at the bottom of the file, which mostly works well)

Oh, I don't really know about the module system - I'll look it up.
But yeah, the #min_imports bit I definitely do.
Thanks a lot.
If you change one file all files that depend on it must be rebuilt.

Hmm. I guess that means that there is no way to automate it that'll just give an error if your changes creates a problem in a different file (and if there is no error, it'll silently and automatically rebuild in the background)?
